# Community guidelines

Be respectful in issues, discussions, and pull requests. Disagree with ideas without attacking the person. Give people room to ask questions and make mistakes.

Harassment, threats, discriminatory remarks, spam, and sharing someone's private information aren't welcome. Maintainers may edit or remove content, lock threads, or block accounts when needed.

For abusive content, use GitHub's **Report content** menu. For account abuse or threats, use [GitHub's reporting options](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam). Don't repeat private or harmful content in a public issue.
